messages:
leah-sales: Heads-up — FinRegCo POC kickoff tomorrow and they are strict about EU-only. They want: list of sub-processors that will touch data, confirmation that KMS keys (customer-managed) never leave EU, routing policy that pins traffic to eu-west and only failsover to eu-standby (no US fallthrough). Also want delta on pricing if we reserve dedicated vs allow burst to other regions. Can infra/security/finance confirm?

devin-plat: @leah-sales I can handle the routing + dedicated sizing part. Quick q: is the POC on Hosted API or Dedicated?

leah-sales: Dedicated (reserved pool) for the POC. Customer will provide KMS in their EU account.

devin-plat: OK. Short answers first: we can pin by tenant->region affinity and provide a standby EU-only failover. KMS keys for customer-managed keys will be configured to use EU key rings only; runtime will not send plaintext keys outside region. Need sec to confirm provenance of subprocessors (some cloud infra ops like monitoring agents).

sanjay-security: @devin-plat correct re: KMS usage. We need to document that we never export customer CMK material. But note: our managed control-plane (in Hosted) has telemetry processors — for Dedicated, if they self-host KMS in their VPC then we don't touch the key material. We should list subprocessors that run in eu-west and eu-standby. I'll attach list in a follow-up.

leah-sales: Customer is explicit: no US egress allowed even on failover. They'll accept only EU standby. Also asked about SOC/ISO attachments and a short statement we can include in contract. @amanda-legal can you prep?

amanda-legal: Can do. We need the subprocessors list and a short routing SLA clause. If security confirms we never route to non-EU when tenant pinned, I'll draft the clause. Also ask FinRegCo if they require data residency audit rights.

ellie-acct: Pricing note — Reserved Dedicated (monthly commit) for the POC will have a lower unit price but minimum commitment is 1 month. If they require strict EU-only standby (no cross-region bursting), that removes our ability to use cheapest pooled capacity and adds ~12% to the monthly cost estimate. I can produce a one-page delta table.

devin-plat: For routing config, sample (simplified) tenant policy we use for pins:
```yaml
tenant_affinity:
  tenant_id: finregco-123
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  standby_regions:
    - eu-west-2
  allow_cross_region_burst: false
  kms_policy: customer_managed_eu_only
```
If allow_cross_region_burst=false, runtime will refuse to route to other partitions. We need to ensure autoscaler can still spin up within EU pool.

leah-sales: Perfect. Two asks before we talk to the customer this afternoon: 1) subprocessors list scoped to eu-west + eu-west-2 and their roles, 2) short KMS statement we can include in the SOW.

sanjay-security: Uploading subprocessors list in thread (condensed): infra-hosting: cloud-provider-eu (VMs, storage), metrics-agent: third-party (eu-only), logging-shipper: partner-logs-eu, monitoring: internal (eu instances). None of the listed subprocessors are US-based for those regions. Full legal attachments will be on the compliance pack.

sanjay-security: KMS statement (draft): "For Dedicated deployments where the customer configures a customer-managed key (CMK) in their EU account/region, Redwood Inference will not export, transmit, or store the key material outside the specified EU regions. All data encryption and decryption operations occur within EU-hosted runtime instances that have network egress controls preventing routing to non-EU regions."

amanda-legal: Thanks. I'll turn that into a 2-sentence clause and attach SOC/ISO pointers. Also asking procurement if they need archive copy retention location declared.

ellie-acct: Pricing delta table queued — will post numbers in 30m. Quick note: if they want guaranteed EU-only standby we need to reserve additional capacity in that region, so delta is per-GPU-month +12% as a headroom baseline.

devin-plat: Ops checklist for POC: 1) Tenant affinity policy applied 2) KMS key configured in customer EU account 3) Autoscaler policy limited to eu pools 4) Observability endpoints in EU 5) No cross-region traffic routes allowed by network ACLs. I'll create a runbook and tag ops-oncall.

infra-bot: runbook-task-created: #POC-FINREGCO-2187654321 (devin-plat)

leah-sales: Great progress. If legal and sec sign off, I can confirm to the customer we meet EU-only constraints and share pricing delta + SOW clause by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devin-plat: tagging @ops-oncall in the runbook for validation of final network ACLs.

sanjay-security: I'll attach the subprocessors CSV and compliance pack link in 10m.

ellie-acct: Posted estimate: reserved-dedicated-monthly = $28,400; eu-only-standby-surcharge = $3,400 (12%); burst-enabled (cross-region) = $0 surcharge but not allowed per customer. Numbers in thread, will send formal quote.

leah-sales: Awesome — I'll package these and run through the customer call. If anything pops up, ping here.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: network-acl, kms-binding, tenant-policy all pending verification.
